def components(mask, w, h):
    px = mask.load()
    seen = bytearray(w * h)
    comps = []
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if px[x, y] and not seen[y * w + x]:
                q = deque([(x, y)]); seen[y * w + x] = 1; cells = []

    return comps

def clean(name):
    im = Image.open(os.path.join(kit, name)).convert('RGBA')
    # квадрат без искажения
    s = max(im.size)
    sq = Image.new('RGBA', (s, s), (0, 0, 0, 0)); sq.paste(im, ((s - im.width) // 2, (s - im.height) // 2))
    im = sq.resize((WORK, WORK), Image.LANCZOS)
    r, g, b, a = im.split()
    w = h = WORK
    core = a.point(lambda v: 255 if v >= 128 else 0)
    comps = components(core, w, h)

    sil = keep.filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(9)).filter(ImageFilter.MinFilter(9))
    sil = ImageChops.lighter(sil, keep)
    # кромка: исходная альфа в полосе 3 px вокруг силуэта; внутри — 255

# v6m M: .meta для PNG иконок kit-v6m: Sprite (Single), alphaIsTransparency, без mipmap, max size по файлу.
import sys, os, hashlib
TPL = open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "png.meta.tpl")).read()
d = sys.argv[1]
for f in sorted(os.listdir(d)):
    if not f.endswith(".png"): continue
    from PIL import Image
    w, h = Image.open(os.path.join(d, f)).size
    guid = hashlib.md5(("onepit-v6m-kit/" + f).encode()).hexdigest()
    open(os.path.join(d, f + ".meta"), "w").write(TPL.replace("@GUID@", guid).replace("@MAX@", str(max(w, h))))
    print(f, guid, w, h)
EOF
